privacy.title: Privacy, in plain language
privacy.intro: This prototype currently keeps app data in your browser. This describes current behavior and is not a substitute for a reviewed privacy policy before public launch.
privacy.deviceText: Gym changes, saved gyms, and the demo sign-in selection are stored in this browser's local storage. They are not synced to other devices. Clearing browser site data removes them.
privacy.locationText: If you grant browser location permission, the app uses your coordinates on the page to sort nearby gyms. This prototype does not send them to an app database.
privacy.servicesText: The map loads tiles from OpenStreetMap servers. Those requests may reveal your IP address to the map provider.
privacy.accountsText: Google sign-in uses Supabase Auth and stores your account profile in the configured Supabase project. Gym listings and favorites use that project when database configuration is enabled; local demo roles are used otherwise.
privacy.sensitiveText: For now, do not enter sensitive personal information in the prototype.

terms.title: A few things to know
terms.intro: This is an early product prototype. These notes describe current limitations and are not reviewed legal terms.
terms.dataText: Gym names, prices, hours, amenities, and contact details are sample or locally entered content at this stage. Confirm all details directly with a gym before travelling or making a purchase.
terms.demoText: Admin editing, saved gyms, and sign-in are local demonstrations. They do not provide a secure account, cloud backup, or cross-device synchronization.
terms.mapText: Map tiles are served by OpenStreetMap tile infrastructure and are subject to its usage policy. The map may be unavailable or rate-limited independently of SarajevoGym.
terms.launchText: The service needs verified listings, production authentication and storage, and professionally reviewed terms before it should be relied on as a public directory.
